recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結 H&E 可見被膜下的大型濾泡，生發中心邊界不規則、套細胞層變薄，小型深染淋巴球呈團塊狀侵入生發中心（箭頭，濾泡溶解 follicle lysis），這是 HIV 相關淋巴結病變的特徵；圖片本身並非顯示血小板低下。
features: Lymph node with intact fibrous capsule and a large expanded lymphoid follicle
Germinal center with irregular outline containing pale tingible-body macrophages and scattered pink histiocytic/dendritic cells
Clusters of small dark lymphocytes infiltrating and disrupting the germinal center (arrow), consistent with follicle lysis
No monotonous neoplastic infiltrate or granulomas evident at this magnification
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows an intact capsule and a markedly enlarged follicle with an irregular germinal center, attenuated mantle zone and scattered tingible-body macrophages. Aggregates of small mantle lymphocytes infiltrate and fragment the germinal center (arrow), a pattern termed follicle lysis. No neoplastic infiltrate is identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with florid follicular hyperplasia with follicle lysis, characteristic of HIV-associated lymphadenopathy; the image does not directly demonstrate thrombocytopenia but reflects the immune dysregulation underlying HIV-related immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Follicles have well-preserved mantle zones without mantle lymphocyte invasion or germinal center fragmentation.
Crowded monotonous follicles lacking tingible-body macrophages and polarity, with BCL2-positive germinal centers.
Shows regressed hyalinized germinal centers with onion-skin mantles or sheets of interfollicular plasma cells; HHV-8 staining in HIV-associated multicentric disease.
Spindle-cell proliferation with slit-like vascular spaces and HHV-8 LANA positivity.
